newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African talk of Manuel ouster "racist" - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: S.African talk of Manuel ouster "racist" - spokesman.

text.p: Reports that white Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin would replace black Finance Minister Trevor Manuel were racist and nonsensical, Erwin's spokesman said on Monday.
"It's completely unfounded and untrue," spokesman Ismail Lagardien told Reuters in response to newspaper reports on Friday that Erwin could replace Manuel in a cabinet reshuffle in February.
"To say we are going to replace our first black finance minister with a white minister, is overt racism," Lagardien said.
"And to say Manuel is going to be fired two months before he presents his budget is nonsensical. Any journalist should realise that," Lagardien said.
His denial echoed one issues earlier by a spokesman for President Nelson Mandela.
"This is not true. There is no intention to do that on the part of the president," Parks Mankahlana said in reaction to continuing market talk of a change in top ministries.
Manuel replaced the non-political Chris Liebenberg as finance minister after he resigned for personal reasons last April.
